expectations.text: Lists Annex IV: hardware devices with security boxes; smart meter gateways; smartcards or similar devices including secure elements
expectations.evidence: Lists hardware devices with security boxes; smart meter gateways; smartcards or similar devices, including secure elements

expectations.text: States there are exactly three critical-product categories
expectations.evidence: Enumerates exactly three Annex IV categories (1-3)

expectations.text: States critical products can be made subject to mandatory EU cybersecurity certification
expectations.evidence: Art. 8(1) delegated acts can require a European cybersecurity certificate at least at 'substantial' to demonstrate conformity

expectations.text: Distinguishes them from Annex III important products (Class I and II)
expectations.evidence: 'No self-assessment is permitted for them, unlike Class I with applied standards or default products' - critical tier distinguished from important classes

expectations.text: Does not add invented entries such as TPMs or HSMs
expectations.evidence: Only the three genuine Annex IV entries; no TPM/HSM or other invented entries
